描述_EN: the height of ‘cong’ varies drastically, ranging from 49 cm to a mere 3 cm. tall ‘cong’ were definitely more difficult to make than short ones. archaeology has revealed that it served a ritual function in neolithic times. the outside walls are usually divided into sections by horizontal cuts in the four corners. a ‘cong’ is a jade cylinder that is square on the outside with a round perforation in the middle. an ancient chinese text called ‘zhouli’ ('rites of zhou') states that the ‘cong’ was used as a sacrifice to the earth.
描述_ZN: "琮 "的高度差异很大，从49厘米到仅有3厘米不等。 高的 "琮 "肯定比短的更难做。 考古学发现它在新石器时代具有祭祀的功能。 外墙通常由四角的横切面分成若干部分。 一个 "琮 "是一个玉筒，外面是方形，中间有一个圆形的孔。 中国古代文献称为 "周礼"（"周礼"），指出 "琮 "是用来祭祀大地的。
